tagline: Autonomous engineering control plane for customer-controlled computers and servers.
description: Connect ChatGPT to authorized development machines through KMJ Desktop Commander. Inspect projects, run allow-listed quality gates, edit project files, and perform policy-controlled engineering operations while keeping privileged and destructive actions behind explicit controls.
privacy_position: Local-first. Customer source code, SSH keys, secrets, and raw execution data remain customer-controlled by default.
